from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """One judgment document with its key metadata for filtering."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="Document title as named in the collection, e.g. '判决文书 X'")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The cause of action (案由) as stated in the document")
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of document: 判决书, 裁定书, 等等")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short excerpt anchoring the cause of action or document type")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    judgment_documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
